result.topic_en: The page ends a remark on infinitesimal transformations and invariants, citing Study's book on ternary forms. It then uses a contour integral to compute the power-series coefficients of a function as trigonometric integrals, and starts a study of first-order differential equations f(x, y, dy/dx) = 0 with polynomial f.
